name: atx-fix-bfd-code-issue
description: Diagnose and fix AWS Transform for mainframe (ATX) 'Discover data paths' extraction errors and warnings raised during business function discovery, on COBOL, PL/I, copybook, BMS, and JCL codebases.

interface.shortDescription: Fix AWS Transform for mainframe extraction errors
interface.longDescription: Parses the AWS Transform bre_transform_debug bundle, correlates findings with the original mainframe source, applies safe business-rule-neutral fixes, and produces a fixed source zip plus a Markdown report.
defaultPrompt: Use the fix-atx-datapath-errors skill to analyze the files in input/ and fix what you can. Write results to output/.
